findings.what_happened: The model incorrectly asserted that 'Is Anybody Out There?' is a song by Great Big Sea, whereas it is a song by K'naan featuring Nelly Furtado (Great Big Sea is a folk rock band, and A Great Big World released an album called 'Is There Anybody Out There?').
findings.quote: "Is Anybody Out There?" is a song by the duo Great Big Sea, and it is known to have charted in Canada.
